title: Enforce No Newline After Region Comment
description: Add statute code/section/wrong-format/newline-after-region to enforce no blank lines between region start marker and region information comments. Implement breach detection for all languages (TS, Go, Python, C#, Rust, Ruby, etc.), implement autofix that removes blank lines, add tests.
summary: Added statute code/section/wrong-format/newline-after-region to enforce no blank lines between region start marker and region information comments. Implemented breach detection for all languages (TS, Go, Python, C#, Rust). Implemented autofixable autofix that removes blank lines. Fixed FormatHeader to not emit blank lines after region start. Fixed pre-existing syntax error (missing closing brace in resolveCopilotEvent). Updated 4 fixed fixture files and 1 expected fixture file. Added 9 comprehensive test subtests covering detection for all 5 languages, no false positive, autofix for sections and header regions. All policy tests pass.
